figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="36,147.3 284,147.3 240.9,72.7" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="21.2" y="149.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="298.5" y="151" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="252" y="62.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text></svg>
figure.alt: Треугольник ABC (углы заданы отношением, рисунок схематичный).

ru.solution_md:
Сумма углов равна $180^{\circ}$: $1x+3x+5x=180^{\circ}$, откуда $x=20^{\circ}$.

Углы: $20^{\circ}$, $60^{\circ}$, $100^{\circ}$. Наименьший — $20^{\circ}$, наибольший — $100^{\circ}$.

Внешний угол вместе со смежным внутренним даёт $180^{\circ}$: $180^{\circ}-20^{\circ}=160^{\circ}$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Путают внешний угол со смежным внутренним либо делят $360^{\circ}$ (а не $180^{\circ}$) в заданном отношении.

figure.alt: ABC úshmúyeshlik (múyeshler qatnası berilgen, súwret shama menen).

kaa.solution_md:
Múyeshler jıyındısı $180^{\circ}$: $1x+3x+5x=180^{\circ}$, bunnan $x=20^{\circ}$.

Múyeshler: $20^{\circ}$, $60^{\circ}$, $100^{\circ}$. Eń kishisi $20^{\circ}$, eń úlkeni $100^{\circ}$.

Sırtqı múyesh qońsı ishki múyesh penen birge $180^{\circ}$ boladı: $180^{\circ}-20^{\circ}=160^{\circ}$.

items.text_md: The exterior angle at the vertex of the smallest angle

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="36,147.3 284,147.3 240.9,72.7" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="21.2" y="149.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="298.5" y="151" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="252" y="62.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC (angles are given by a ratio; the sketch is approximate).

en.solution_md:
The angles add up to $180^{\circ}$: $1x+3x+5x=180^{\circ}$, so $x=20^{\circ}$.

The angles are $20^{\circ}$, $60^{\circ}$, $100^{\circ}$. The smallest is $20^{\circ}$, the largest is $100^{\circ}$.

An exterior angle and the adjacent interior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$: $180^{\circ}-20^{\circ}=160^{\circ}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Confusing the exterior angle with another angle instead of the adjacent interior one, or splitting $360^{\circ}$ rather than $180^{\circ}$ in the given ratio.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="43.3,184 276.7,184 191.3,36" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="29.3" y="189.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="290.3" y="190.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="194.4" y="21.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text></svg>
figure.alt: ABC úshmúyeshlik (múyeshler qatnası berilgen, súwret shama menen).

kaa.solution_md:
Múyeshler jıyındısı $180^{\circ}$: $3x+4x+5x=180^{\circ}$, bunnan $x=15^{\circ}$.

Múyeshler: $45^{\circ}$, $60^{\circ}$, $75^{\circ}$. Eń kishisi $45^{\circ}$, eń úlkeni $75^{\circ}$.

Sırtqı múyesh qońsı ishki múyesh penen birge $180^{\circ}$ boladı: $180^{\circ}-45^{\circ}=135^{\circ}$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Sırtqı múyeshti qońsı ishki múyesh penen emes, basqa múyesh penen shatastırıw yamasa qatnastı $180^{\circ}$ qa emes, $360^{\circ}$ qa bóliw.

items.text_md: The exterior angle at the vertex of the smallest angle

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="43.3,184 276.7,184 191.3,36" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="29.3" y="189.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="290.3" y="190.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="194.4" y="21.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text></svg>
figure.alt: Triangle ABC (angles are given by a ratio; the sketch is approximate).

en.solution_md:
The angles add up to $180^{\circ}$: $3x+4x+5x=180^{\circ}$, so $x=15^{\circ}$.

The angles are $45^{\circ}$, $60^{\circ}$, $75^{\circ}$. The smallest is $45^{\circ}$, the largest is $75^{\circ}$.

An exterior angle and the adjacent interior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$: $180^{\circ}-45^{\circ}=135^{\circ}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Confusing the exterior angle with another angle instead of the adjacent interior one, or splitting $360^{\circ}$ rather than $180^{\circ}$ in the given ratio.

questions.solution_md:
Burchaklar yig'indisi $180^{\circ}$: $2x+3x+5x=180^{\circ}$, bundan $x=18^{\circ}$.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="36,155.4 284,155.4 193.2,64.6" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="21.4" y="158.7" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="298.5" y="159.3" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="198.4" y="50.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">C</text></svg>

en.solution_md:

The angles are $30^{\circ}$, $45^{\circ}$, $105^{\circ}$. The smallest is $30^{\circ}$, the largest is $105^{\circ}$.
